# React Base Copilot Instructions

These instructions guide Copilot on how to assist with the React Base project.

## Context

This is a shadcn registry published on GitHub. It contains React components, hooks and
utilities for building user interfaces. The project follows a consistent code
style and structure to ensure maintainability and ease of use. Copilot should
adhere to the established patterns and conventions when generating code for this
project.

## Guidelines

- Follow the existing file and folder structure.
- Use consistent naming conventions for components, hooks, and utilities.
- Ensure code is readable and maintainable.
- Write comments where necessary to explain complex logic.
- Avoid introducing breaking changes to the public API.
- Follow the project's styling and formatting rules.
- Prefer using TypeScript for type safety and maintainability.
- Ensure components are reusable and composable.
- Follow accessibility best practices when building UI components.
- Write tests to ensure component functionality and prevent regressions.
- Keep dependencies up to date and follow best practices for package management.
- Ensure proper error handling and edge case coverage in components and utilities.
- Follow best practices for performance optimization in React components.
- Ensure proper state management and avoid unnecessary re-renders.
- Follow best practices for handling side effects in React components.
- Keep the shadcn registry.json files in sync with the actual components
